Original contiguous pool defaults extend through ATTR_MARGIN143. Standard uniform-script unwrapped/unrotated rows use native 256-twip startup minimum,23-twip correction,margin/emphasis and pixel-change conditions. Selected sheets retain one original shared context. React uses actual row segments and bounded physical scrolling; ODS row styles apply to real sheet storage. Device-based initialization/script scanning,rich/wrapped/rotated/merged layout,drawing/hidden rows and standalone height dialogs remain unported. Nonstandard represented attribute profiles decline adjustment;unrepresented foreign layout properties,mixed-script text and device layout remain unverified. Writer primary saving/no-recovery/visible-content policy is retained; broad parity remains unverified. Task76 adds original copy-reference context values, insertion-only global-name normalization, sparse column sets, ScFormulaCell copy-update/compile metadata and actual document/table/column copy traversal with boundary group joins. Compiled references remain owned by the existing token arrays; no formula-source reparse is used to relocate references. Non-copy shift/move engines and absent names/drawing/printing/validation/embedded/UNO/formatter services remain unrepresented. Task76 native UndoToColumn/UndoToTable restore the edited payload,formula-only cells outside its rows/columns,whole conditional-format ownership,and full-axis raw geometry/manual breaks with actual null geometry checks. Marked copying retains the original null-mark-data asymmetry (CALC-265). Real table5 page/manual sets,ordered set value/move binding,stream-validity state/document locking and width-change pagination invalidation are represented. Named-expression maps,pagination/device calculation,full XML streaming and native document-level Undo/paste/history orchestration remain unported;no fake owner or alternate workbook is introduced. AQF9AG relocates the existing connected-area algorithm into its original table1 source responsibility with unchanged bounds, expansion and shrinking; the actual ScTable owner forwards to this fragment.
